name: Wickling
description:
A moth with a candle wick for a body, guttering and bright. Residents cannot look away from it.

{key.summon} sends it where you aim, within {range} paces. Costs {cost} summon charge. Residents nearby are drawn to its light for {seconds} seconds, heedless of you.

text.callHint: {key.summon} · Send the Wickling where you aim
